;Disasters and accidents
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**A [[2019 Venezuelan blackout|major power blackout]] leaves most of [[Venezuela]] without electricity, including the capital [[Caracas]]. At least 18 of Venezuela's 23 [[States of Venezuela|states]] have reported blackouts. Venezuelan news website El Pitazo blames failures at [[Guri Dam|Simón Bolívar hydroelectric plant]]; state TV blames anti-government saboteurs. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/mar/07/venezuela-hit-by-major-power-outage (''The Guardian'')]
